title: Taskthread — One Task Board for You and Your AI Assistants
excerpt: One plan for you and your AI assistants, plus an hour-by-hour day planner, meeting notes that become tasks, and kanban boards.
content_html:
Start a plan in Claude, pick it up in another assistant tomorrow — the tasks, notes and hand-offs live in Taskthread, on your phone and under your control. With kanban boards, a calendar, an AI day plan and a meeting notetaker. Free to start — Pro is $4.99/mo.

See pricing

Every chat with an assistant starts from zero, and no assistant knows what another one did. Connect them to Taskthread and they share one place: what is planned, who is on it, and where it stopped.

Pick up where any AI left off

An assistant leaves a note on the task before it stops. The next chat — or a different assistant — starts from that note, not from scratch.

Every card says who did it

Cards and their history show which assistant created, moved or commented on a task — and what you did yourself.

Never two AIs on one task

An assistant claims a task before working on it, so another one waits. When it is done it hands the task to another assistant or to you.

You decide what each one sees

When you connect an assistant you can limit it to chosen boards, and disconnect it at any time. None of them can delete anything.

One screen, on the web and in the app, shows every assistant you connected.

  • See what each one did lately: completed, handed on, commented on — under its own name.
  • Change which boards it sees, or disconnect it. Its very next request is refused.
  • Going the other way: send any task to an AI as a clean, prompt-ready copy, straight from the task.

Connect any assistant that supports MCP connectors with this address — in ChatGPT, Plugins → Add → Custom MCP server. We use it with Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor; in Claude Code it is one line:

claude mcp add --transport http taskthread https://taskthread.denegra.ai/mcp

Shared by all your AIs

Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP assistant. Each one signs its work, leaves a note where it stopped, and steps aside when another is on a task.

Shared boards

Invite people as editors or viewers and assign them tasks. Two people editing one task never silently overwrite each other.

Boards

Kanban boards for every part of your life — work, home, side projects.

Assistant

Type, talk or paste anything — it becomes tasks, right where they belong.

Meeting Notetaker

Record a meeting and get the summary and action items automatically.

Calendar & Day Plan

Every task has a date, and AI lays out your day hour by hour.

Reminders

Notifications on web and Android before things slip.

Smart suggestions

AI connects the dots across your boards and proposes the next step.

Export & share

Take any filtered slice out as a checklist or meeting note, or share a list with a link.

Recurring tasks

Daily, weekly or monthly — finish one and the next appears with its date already set.

Teams

Colleagues join with a code, and one switch shares a board with the whole team — including whoever joins later.

Files

A small drive, personal or per board. Attach a file to a task straight from it, and find it again in search.

Start free. Upgrade when you need unlimited.

  • Up to 5 boards
  • Unlimited tasks, calendar & day plan
  • 3 recorded meetings a month (20 min each) and an AI capture allowance
  • Join shared boards and teams; 100 MB of Files

7-day free trial

$39.99/yr · Save 33%

  • Unlimited voice & text capture
  • Unlimited AI Day Plan
  • 5 hours of meetings a month, up to 3 hours each
  • Unlimited boards
  • Cross-board suggestion refresh
  • Share task boards and create a team
  • 2 GB of Files

Have a code? Redeem it inside the app after signing up.

Is there a free plan, or just a trial?

There is a permanent free plan, not a trial. Free gives you up to 5 boards, unlimited tasks, the full calendar and day plan, and a monthly allowance of AI captures. Pro lifts the AI limits and is $4.99/mo or $39.99/yr, with a 7-day trial.

What does the AI day plan actually do?

You say what you want to focus on — including things that are not tasks, like a gym session or dinner — and it lays the day out hour by hour around what is already on your calendar.

Can it take meeting notes and turn them into tasks?

Yes. Record a meeting and Taskthread transcribes it, writes a summary, and proposes action items. You accept the ones that matter and they become tasks in the board you choose — in the same app as your plan, not exported somewhere else.

Which AI assistants can use Taskthread, and can they work together?

Any assistant that supports remote MCP connectors can connect to https://taskthread.denegra.ai/mcp — we use it with Claude, ChatGPT (as a custom MCP server, on the free plan too) and Cursor. Each one appears under its own name, sees only the boards you allow, claims a task before working on it so two never collide, leaves a note for whoever continues, and can hand work to another assistant or to you. None of them can delete anything: that is deliberate.

Is my data used to train AI models?

No. AI features send the relevant text, audio or image to Microsoft Azure OpenAI to produce the result, and your content is not used to train models and is not sold. Details are in the privacy policy.

Is there a mobile app?

Yes. Taskthread is on the App Store for iPhone and on Google Play for Android, and it works in any browser. Everything stays in sync.

Taskthread on Google Play →

Can I share a board with other people or a team?

Yes. Invite someone to a board by email as an editor (adds and changes tasks) or a viewer (only looks), or create a team that colleagues join with a code and share a board with all of them at once. Being invited or joining a team is free; sharing a task board and creating a team are part of Pro. Category boards such as books or restaurants are free to share.
